answer_1.quote: we propose Iterative Prompt Refinement (IPR), a framework that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to iteratively refine user prompts by analyzing the behavior of the T2I model in response to them.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our experiments using three metrics: (1) Inappropriate Probability (IP) measures how often a generated image is classified as inappropriate... (2) Confidence Score (CS) quantifies the Q16 classifier's certainty... (3) BLIP Score assesses the semantic alignment between generated images and their corresponding textual prompts using the BLIP model.
